facts.fact: CRAN launched the first phase of the USF tower at Epinga, Ohangwena, on 19 November 2025, and says phase one will give over 9,000 Namibians 4G access.
CRAN awarded phase-two USF subsidies of N$42.1 million to MTC (eight sites) and Telecom Namibia (three sites) for rural and underserved regions.
